title: Simplified Charon Week 1 baseline
subtitle: Qwen2.5-1.5B / NVIDIA L4 / BF16 / batch 1
note: Inputs for benchmarks/roofline.py. Every value carries a 'kind'. 'measured' values are NOT stored here — they are read from the committed result file by key path, so this file cannot drift from the run. Derived values are never stored; the script computes them.

weights_vram_bytes.label: weights resident in VRAM at load

peak_bf16_flops.source: NVIDIA L4 datasheet, dense BF16 tensor core (242 with sparsity). Not measured.

parameters.source: Published Qwen2.5-1.5B count, rounded; consistent with weights_vram_bytes / 2 B per bf16 param = 1.5437e9.

flops_per_param_per_token.source: Standard 2N forward-pass approximation (one multiply-add per weight). Ignores attention-score FLOPs (small at a 128-token context) and elementwise ops.

bytes_per_token_model.source: Simplified traffic model: every decode step reads the full weight set from DRAM once (weights >> the L4's L2, so no reuse across steps). Ignores KV-cache, activation and logits traffic, so it UNDER-counts bytes moved.

gpu_cost_inr_per_hour.source: Owner-supplied 2026-10-05 as the observed effective GPU rate. Not traced to a committed billing record; differs from the ~₹41.9/h spot list price in docs/gcp-setup.md. Not a guaranteed GCP price.

cost_duty_cycle.source: Cost/token assumes the instance generates at the stated rate for every billed second — no idle, no setup, no prefill time. Real cost per token is higher.
